465340.overview: Blob Attack is a falling block puzzle game inspired by Puyo Pop Fever. The game plays the same as most Puyo Puyo variants. Sets of two blobs fall from the top, and each blob can be one of five types. You need to match at least four of the same blobs in order to clear them and increase your score. You can see the next two upcoming sets of blobs on the side of the play field. The left, right, and down buttons on the directional pad are used to move the sets of blobs, and the two face buttons are used to rotate them clockwise and counterclockwise. The more points you score, the faster the sets of blobs fall. Once all the blobs pile up to the top of the screen, you lose the game.

465901.overview: BiriBiriBeat is a miniature rhythm game experience in a microscopic 28KB package. Join your robotic guide Navi and groove together to square wave sounds as you tap your way to the top of the scoreboard! This game is designed and compiled for the Arduboy handheld game system.

470912.overview: The Bounce is a bouncy ball physics platformer game. Simple to understand yet incredibly hard to master, what seems easy at first glance is actually pretty rage inducing when you get to the later levels.
